threshold.sourceRo: renewable by the nature of the investment; the sizing against consumption is checked

requiredDocs.labelRo: Offer / pro forma and technical data sheet of the installation
Electricity invoices for the last 12 months

questionnaire.labelRo: Where will the panels be mounted?
What area do you have available for panels (m²)?
What share of your energy use happens during the day (approx., %)?
If you are replacing a diesel pump with a solar one: how many litres does the current pump use per year?
Do you have the grid connection approval for selling surplus to the grid?
In which months do you receive the most income?
What do you do with the old equipment you are replacing (inverters, cables, pumps)?

options.labelRo: I keep it as a spare

dnsh.checkRo: The panels are not on parcels at high risk of flooding or hail, or they are insured.
The panels are cleaned without new water sources and without detergents reaching water bodies.
At end of life, panels and inverters are handed over to an authorised e-waste collector; the old equipment is sold or handed over to an authorised collector.
The equipment is certified (IEC 61215 / 61730) and contains no hazardous substances above EU limits.
The parcels are not in Natura 2000 areas, or there is an environmental approval; the panels do not occupy productive farmland.

pvYieldKwhPerKwp.sourceRo: Specific yield of the panels, southern Romania; starting value from the Product test documents (data/demo/test-documents/reference/constants.json), to be replaced with PVGIS for the farm's location

monthlyProductionShare.sourceRo: Monthly production profile, January–December, sums to 1; demo profile (data/demo/test-documents/reference/constants.json), to be replaced with PVGIS

sellPriceEurPerKwh.sourceRo: Selling price of the surplus fed into the grid; demo value (data/demo/test-documents/reference/constants.json), to be confirmed with the mentors

maxExportSharePct.sourceRo: Sizing rule from the Product demo: at most 30% of production sold to the grid; an oversized installation sells cheaply

daytimeShareDefaultPct.sourceRo: README §6, category 2: daytime share of consumption, e.g. 55%; used only if the farmer does not answer

areaM2PerKwp.sourceRo: Roof area per kWp, from the Solar Câmpia Demo test offer: 1,650 m² for 300 kWp; estimate, to be validated

eligibleMountings.sourceRo: README §6, category 2, green threshold: roof, unproductive land or agrivoltaic; productive farmland is not eligible
